name: apple-podcasts-show-cover
description: Apple Podcasts show cover, 3000x3000 JPG (RGB, no alpha channel: JPEG has none). Show title big and high (capitals about 300 px tall or more so it still reads at 55-60 px), one simple mark, solid not-quite-black background, nothing important in the bottom fifth (y > 2400) or the corners. Brand-neutral placeholder: swap colours, font, title and mark for the project's brand inputs; supplied art goes in as image layers (crop from 3000 px or larger sources; record any upscale).
